title: Cyn Totem
description: Replaces totem with Cyn from Murder Drones
body:
Replaces the totem with Cyn from Murder Drones. It also replaces the totem sound with the phrase "Curious about what happens after you d83, right?". 

Заменяет тотем бессмертия на Син из Дронов Убийц. Так же заменяет звук тотема на фразу "Curious about what happens after you d83, right?"
